methodology: Retrieved every CI job page with per_page=100 and checked total_count, unique IDs, exact expected successful job names, two exact PR-only skipped placeholders, completed statuses, and commit identity for all 70 jobs.
Checked actual successful aggregate Require complete verification reports and Require every verification group steps and preserved both full aggregate job logs.

Downloaded the original aggregate ZIP bytes and independently matched their byte lengths and SHA-256 digests to the GitHub artifact metadata. Each ZIP contains the raw verification.json without duplication outside the archive.

Created a detached checkout of the exact merged commit, confirmed its tree, and recomputed all 58 compiler/runtime source hashes, corpus counts, deterministic weighted shard counts, GC sample counts, and the complete source fingerprint.

Ran the repository's full-profile report validator on both aggregates, then independently checked all 33 report group names/paths/step counts, all 56 checks in their planned order, all full-suite shard totals, both opt-in suites' exact case/mode pair coverage and declared exception manifests, and all scaling shapes.
Inspected the actual pinned Lean checksum/build/audit/test log block; all 28 boundary tests ran under LEAN_BOUNDARY_REQUIRED=1 with no skips. The full retrieved Lint log is also retained as gzip.
No CI cancellation, restart, remote mutation, or native build was performed by this audit.

Additionally checked the aggregate native and optimization-off stage-2 JIT/AOT mode fields, Python-free PATH isolation and identical IR, and actual UBSan AOT/JIT flags, preload and identical-IR fields on every shard.
interpretation_notes: Full-profile native reports attest deterministic shard/check counts rather than storing per-case lists; expected case-list hashes in this summary are independently reconstructed from the checkout. Both opt-in sweeps include and validate exact case/mode result rows.
Known opt-in exceptions are intentional manifest entries checked exactly; their counts are not new failures. Deferred native-ir checks are backed by the complete native JIT/AOT suite.

Aggregate summary.seconds is the bootstrap plus the longest consumer group's verification work, not an individual job duration. Actual longest job duration was 795 seconds, within the unchanged 900-second cap.

The source fingerprint equals the reviewed c355f306 release-candidate fingerprint because the ordinary merge preserved tree bc34d9b1. Commit identity in these main-run reports is the actual merge commit 04860a83.
